{{Quote|I'm from Monsolar. Little backwater dirt-cloud tucked into the Alzoc system.|Waleed Nagma|<ref name="TSR" />}}
'''Monsolar''' was a backwater [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Alzoc system/Legends|Alzoc system]], with the the [[Sujimis sector/Legends|Sujimis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The planet was home to the [[Syrox]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of parasitic worm, which laid its eggs in the planet's rivers, where they were consumed by other animals and grew within their new hosts. The [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] natives of the planet lived in several warring tribal communities, most of which either worshiped or feared the Syrox. [[Waleed Nagma]] was a native of this planet, but after becoming infested by a Syrox he ended up in the [[Cog Hive Seven]] prison.
